app.title: Restaurant POS
app.pitch: Sales, stock, recipes, purchasing and central kitchen in one place. On desktop, tablet and phone.

auth.codeHelp: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth.enrollHelp: Your role requires an authenticator app (for example Google Authenticator). Add this key, then enter the code it shows.
auth.recoveryHelp: Each code works once if you lose your phone. They are shown only now.

google.failed: Could not sign in with Google. Please try again.
google.noAccount: This Google account is not invited to any business. Ask the owner to invite this email.

shell.noBusiness: You are not a member of any active business yet.

subscription.expiring: Your subscription ends in {{count}} days. Transfer and message the admin to extend.
subscription.grace: Your subscription has ended. You have a short grace period: please renew.
subscription.read_only: Your subscription has ended. You can view and export, but not make changes.

dashboard.empty: Your figures appear here once daily sales and stock are recorded (Phase 1).

install.title: Install the app
install.body: Open it from your home screen or desktop, in its own window.

errors.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Please wait and try again.
errors.invalid_code: That code is not valid. Try the newest code.
errors.session_expired: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
errors.permission_denied: You do not have permission for this.
errors.module_disabled: This module is switched off for your business.
errors.network_error: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.invalid_setting: Some values are not valid. Check the highlighted fields.
errors.service_charge_not_allowed: Cloud kitchens cannot charge a service charge.
errors.invalid_reference: Something you selected no longer exists. Reload and try again.
errors.not_found: Not found. It may have been removed; reload the page.
errors.validation_error: Some values are not valid. Check the highlighted fields.
errors.unit_code_taken: A unit with this code already exists.
errors.category_name_taken: A category with this name already exists here.
errors.category_cycle: A category cannot be inside itself.
errors.category_too_deep: Categories can be nested at most 20 levels.
errors.sku_taken: Another item already uses this SKU.
errors.stale_version: Someone else saved this item first. Reload to see their change.
errors.base_unit_locked: The base unit cannot change after the item is created.
errors.conversion_to_base_unit: A conversion cannot use the base unit itself.
errors.no_unit_conversion: This unit has no conversion for the item.
errors.channel_code_taken: A channel with this code already exists.
errors.channel_code_locked: A channel code cannot change after it is created.
errors.price_conflict: Someone saved a price for the same date. Reload and try again.
errors.price_already_started: This price has already started; add a new start date instead.
errors.bom_not_found: This recipe version no longer exists.
errors.bom_not_draft: An active recipe cannot change. Start a new version instead.
errors.bom_start_too_early: The start date must be after the current version starts.
errors.bom_cycle: A recipe cannot contain itself, also not through another recipe.
errors.bom_too_deep: Recipes can be nested at most 10 levels.
errors.ingredient_has_no_recipe: Ingredients are bought, so they have no recipe.
errors.component_not_stock_item: Only ingredients and semi-finished items can go into a recipe.
errors.yield_required: Say how much one batch makes.
errors.batch_insufficient: That batch does not hold enough.
errors.expiry_required: This item spoils: enter an expiry date.
errors.item_not_stocked: This item is not tracked in stock.
errors.opening_after_movements: This item already has stock movements here; opening stock must come first.
errors.batch_already_used: Part of this stock is already used, so it cannot be undone.
errors.outlet_not_found: This outlet does not exist or is inactive.
errors.wrong_status: This document has already moved on. Reload to see its status.
errors.approver_role_required: Your role cannot approve this; the approval rule names another role.
errors.cannot_approve_own_request: You cannot approve your own request.
errors.count_incomplete: Enter a counted quantity for every line first.
errors.items_required: Choose at least one item to count.
errors.invalid_image: This file is not a supported image. Use JPEG, PNG or WebP.
errors.upload_too_large: This file is too large. The limit is 8 MB.
errors.ai_disabled: AI images are not switched on.
errors.tenant_daily_limit: Your business used all free AI images for today. Try again tomorrow.
errors.platform_daily_limit: Free AI images are used up for today. Try again tomorrow.
errors.ai_provider_error: The image service did not answer. Your free image was not used up; try again.
errors.invalid_file: This file could not be read. Use the template (.xlsx or .csv, UTF-8).
errors.already_imported: This exact file was imported before. See past imports.
errors.rows_invalid: Some rows have problems. Check the file and try again.
errors.missing_columns: The file is missing required columns. Start from the template.
errors.too_many_rows: The file has too many rows (maximum 2,000).
errors.not_utf8: Save the CSV as UTF-8, or use the Excel template.
errors.not_estimated: Only estimated items can be set directly. Use a stock count or adjustment.
errors.invoice_required: This business requires a photo of the supplier invoice for every purchase.
errors.vendor_name_taken: A vendor with this name already exists.
errors.quantity_too_small: A quantity is too small to record.
errors.more_than_ordered: That is more than was ordered. Check the quantity or make a new order.
errors.not_producible: Only stocked semi-finished items can be produced.
errors.output_as_component: An item cannot be used to make itself.
errors.reason_required: Say why less arrived (short or damaged).
errors.day_locked: This day is locked. Ask a manager to reopen it.
errors.price_missing: Some items have no price on this channel for this day.
errors.unknown_platform_code: Some platform codes are not mapped to items.
errors.reported_above_list: The reported total is higher than the list total.
errors.range_too_long: Choose a period of at most one year.
errors.modifier_group_not_found: That modifier group no longer exists.
errors.modifier_group_name_taken: A modifier group with this name already exists.
errors.option_not_found: An option was removed by someone else. Reload and try again.
errors.not_a_menu_item: Only menu items can have modifiers.
errors.shift_required: Open your cash drawer (shift) before taking payment.
errors.shift_already_open: You already have an open shift at this outlet.
errors.payment_total_mismatch: The payments do not add up to the amount due.
errors.tendered_mismatch: Only cash can be more than the amount; card and QRIS must be exact.
errors.tips_disabled: Tips are switched off in the settings.
errors.order_empty: Add something to the order first.
errors.line_already_sent: This line was already sent to the kitchen. Voiding comes in a later update.
errors.order_has_sent_lines: Something was already sent to the kitchen, so the order cannot be cancelled.
errors.modifier_selection: Check the options: some groups need a different number of choices.
errors.payment_method_not_found: That payment method is not active.
errors.limit_exceeded: That is more than your role allows. Ask someone with a higher limit.
errors.discount_too_large: The discount is larger than the amount.
errors.refund_exists: A refund for this order is already waiting or done.
errors.role_lacks_permission: That role does not have this permission.
errors.table_occupied: Guests are seated at that table.
errors.floor_name_taken: A floor with this name exists.
errors.table_name_taken: A table with this name exists.
errors.recall_too_late: Too late to recall this ticket.
errors.station_name_taken: A station with this name exists.
errors.pin_not_allowed: Owners and co-owners always sign in with password and 2FA.
errors.device_not_found: This browser is not a registered device.
errors.invalid_combo: A combo cannot list an item twice or contain itself.
errors.combo_in_combo: A combo cannot contain another combo.
errors.account_name_taken: An account with this name exists.
errors.receipt_not_found: That receipt was not found or is reversed.
errors.duplicate_vendor_invoice: This vendor invoice number is already entered.
errors.receipt_already_billed: A receipt is already on another bill.
errors.payment_exceeds_balance: The payment is more than what is still owed.
errors.credit_note_missing: Record the vendor's credit note first.
errors.credit_already_applied: This credit is already used on a bill.
errors.credit_exceeds_balance: The credit is more than what the bill still owes.
errors.bill_mismatch: This bill does not match its order and receipts, and your settings block paying it.
errors.bill_not_open: This bill is already paid or void.
errors.bill_has_settlements: A bill with payments or credits cannot be voided.
errors.already_credited: A credited return cannot be undone.
errors.receipt_mismatch: The receipt is from another vendor or outlet.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Choose light or dark mode, an accent colour and a background.

settings.title: Settings
settings.readOnly: You can view these settings. Only owners and co-owners can change them.

tax.help: Rates are set per business; check regional rates with your tax advisor.
tax.name: Name
tax.invalidRate: Enter a percentage from 0 to 100, at most 2 decimals.

service.cloudKitchen: Cloud kitchens never charge a service charge.

approvals.help: Documents at or above the amount need approval from this role.

stock.help: What happens when more is used than the system shows on hand.
stock.expiryDays: Warn this many days before a batch expires (0 to 60)
stock.lowDays: Alert when stock lasts fewer days than this (0 turns it off)
stock.countVariance: Alert when a count's difference is worth at least (0 turns it off)

production.includeRequests: Add branch requests to the prep list
production.help: On by default. Open transfer requests from other outlets, due by the day, are added to the sending kitchen's prep list on top of its par levels.

purchasing.requireInvoice: Require a photo of the supplier invoice on every purchase
purchasing.help: Off by default. When on, a purchase cannot be saved without the photo.
purchasing.tolerance: Bill price may exceed the order price by (%)
purchasing.blockMismatch: Do not allow paying a bill that does not match its order and receipts
purchasing.matchHelp: Bills are checked against the purchase order and what was received. Flagged bills show why; by default they can still be paid.

catalog.help: Menu items whose food cost (HPP) on any channel rises above this share of the net price raise an alert. Items can set their own target. Leave empty to turn it off.

pos.requireShift: Payments need an open cash shift
pos.roundingStep: Round cash bills to (0 = off, e.g. 100)
pos.help: Rounding applies only when the whole bill is paid in cash; the difference is recorded on the sale. Tips are kept apart from sales.
pos.voidEffect: When a cooked item is voided
pos.voidWaste: Write its ingredients off as waste

limits.help: The biggest discount each role may give, in percent. Leave empty for no limit. A bigger discount needs someone whose limit covers it.

kitchen.recall: Bumped tickets can be recalled for (minutes)

receipt.header: Lines above the sale (address, tax number, phone)
receipt.footer: Lines below the sale (thank you, Wi-Fi, social media)
receipt.help: Used on printed receipts and the receipt PDF.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.readOnly: You can view the catalog. Ask a manager to change items or prices.

items.empty: No items yet. Add your first menu item or ingredient.
items.noMatch: No items match. Try another word or type.

problems.sku: SKU: letters, digits and . _ / - only, up to 64.
problems.name: Enter a name in at least one language.
problems.shelfLife: Shelf life is a whole number of days.
problems.conversion: Each conversion needs a different unit and a number above 0.

conversions.title: Unit conversions
conversions.help: For example 1 box = 2500 (base units). Kilograms and grams, litres and millilitres convert automatically.
conversions.factor: Base units in 1 of this unit

prices.title: Prices per channel
prices.help: A price applies from its start date until a newer one starts. Promotions are discounts on the sale, not prices.
prices.noChannels: Add a sales channel first (Catalog, Sales channels).

channels.help: Where you sell: dine-in, takeaway, each delivery app, wholesale. Each can have its own prices.
channels.name: Name

recipe.title: Recipe
recipe.help: What one unit is made of. Saved changes stay a draft until you activate them from a start date; sales and production keep the version they used.
recipe.costUnknown: Cost not known yet: ingredient costs come from purchases and stock, which arrive in a later update.
recipe.margin: Price without tax {{price}} Â· margin {{margin}} Â· HPP {{pct}} %

problems.qty: Each line needs a quantity above 0 and a unit.
problems.yield: Say how much one batch makes.

photo.title: Photo
photo.optional: Optional. JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 8 MB.
photo.tooBig: This file is larger than 8 MB.

ai.title: Create a photo with AI (free)
ai.privacy: Only the words you type are sent to the image service. Nothing else about your business.
ai.placeholder: e.g. bibimbap in a stone bowl, top view

import.title: Import items from Excel or CSV
import.help: Download the template, fill one item per row, then choose the file. Nothing is saved until every row is correct.
import.tooBig: This file is larger than 5 MB.
import.problems_one: {{count}} problem to fix in the file:
import.problems_other: {{count}} problems to fix in the file:

fields.sku_taken: SKU already exists or repeats in the file

import.recipesTitle: Import recipes from Excel or CSV
import.recipesHelp: One row per ingredient line, grouped by the dish SKU. Each dish gets a draft recipe; open the dish and activate it when it looks right.
import.createCategories: Create categories that do not exist yet

tracking.exactHelp: Every movement counts; shortages follow your stock rules.
tracking.estimatedHelp: For things hard to measure (rice, oil). Never blocks a sale or waste entry; correct it with "Set on hand".
tracking.untrackedHelp: No stock is kept (for example gas). Add a standard cost so recipes still show a full cost.

platformCodes.title: Platform item codes
platformCodes.help: The code the platform uses for each menu item, so platform sales entered by code reach the right recipe.

modifiers.help: Choices on a menu item, like size, add-ons or spice level. An option can change the price and take more or less of an ingredient.
modifiers.name: Group name
modifiers.selectHelp: 0 = optional. For one required choice (like size) use 1 and 1.
modifiers.title: Sale options
modifiers.available: Available for sale (untick when sold out)

combo.title: Combo
combo.help: Make this a combo: list the menu items it includes. Its own price applies; stock is taken for each item in it.
combo.add: Add a menu item to the combo

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.empty: No stock recorded at this outlet yet.
inventory.negative: Below zero: more was used than was recorded in
inventory.fefo: Used in this order: earliest expiry first.

opening.help: Enter what this outlet holds when it starts. Each item can get an opening stock once; to fix a mistake, undo it and post again.
opening.undone: Undone. The reversal is kept in the history.
opening.importTitle: Import opening stock from Excel or CSV
opening.importHelp: One row per item and outlet, with the outlet name as in Outlets. Perishable items need an expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD or DD/MM/YYYY).

docs.adjustHelp: Use adjustments only when no count, waste or delivery explains the change. Larger changes wait for approval.
docs.blind: Blind count (counters do not see the system quantity)
docs.blindHelp: Count what is physically there. The system quantity appears after you submit.

setOnHand.title: Set what is on hand
setOnHand.help: This item is estimated. Enter what is really there now; the difference is recorded as a correction.
setOnHand.done: Saved. Stock now matches what you entered.

levels.help: Targets per item at this outlet, in the item's base unit. Par drives the daily prep list; min, reorder point and max drive alerts.

producible.help: How many of each dish or prepared item the stock here can still make. The ingredient that runs out first is shown.

trace.help: Type a lot code to find a batch, then see what it was made from, where it went and which documents used it.
trace.none: No batch with this lot code at your outlets.
trace.hidden_one: {{count}} batch is at an outlet you cannot see.
trace.hidden_other: {{count}} batches are at outlets you cannot see.

quick.help: Record what you bought at the market or paid in cash. Stock is added at once and the price updates the average cost.

receipts.empty: Nothing received at this outlet yet.

orders.empty: No purchase orders for this outlet yet.

reorder.help: Items at or below their reorder point, grouped by vendor (preferred vendor first, else the cheapest). Quantities are rounded up to whole packs.
reorder.empty: Nothing to reorder. Set reorder points under Inventory, Levels.

issue.price_over_po: Billed price {{price}} is above the order price {{po}}.
issue.not_on_po: This item is not on the purchase order.

production.title: Production
production.used: {{name}} used ({{unit}}), leave empty to use the recipe

prep.help: Items below their par level or requested by other outlets for today, minus stock and what is already planned.
prep.empty: Everything is at par and nothing is requested. Set par levels under Inventory, Levels.

transfers.title: Transfers
transfers.empty: No transfers for this outlet yet.
transfers.emptyMeansAll: Leave a quantity empty to keep it as shown.

kinds.food_cost_above_target: {{item}}: food cost {{pct}} % on {{channel}}, target {{target}} %. Biggest cost: {{cause}}

sales.title: Daily sales
sales.noPrices: No menu items have a price on this channel for this day. Set prices in the catalog.
sales.reported: Total reported by the platform or till (optional; the difference is the promo)

reports.title: Reports
reports.none: No reports are available for your role.

pos.title: Cashier
pos.noItems: No menu items with a price on this channel. Add prices in the catalog.
pos.chooseOptions: Choose the options, then add to the order.
pos.label: Name or table (optional)
pos.noOpenOrders: No open orders. Tap a menu item to start one.
pos.emptyOrder: Nothing on this order yet. Tap menu items to add them.
pos.payHelp: Choose how the customer pays. Split between methods if needed.

shift.openHelp: Count the cash in the drawer before the first sale. Payments are recorded on your shift.
shift.closeHelp: At the end of your shift, count all cash in the drawer and enter the total.

pos.reasonHelp: Write a short reason. It is kept in the audit log.
pos.stockReturn: Goes back to stock (not made or untouched)

refundStatus.requested: Refund of {{amount}} is waiting for a manager.

tables.title: Tables
tables.empty: No tables on this floor yet.
tables.splitConfirm: Move ticked items to a new bill

kitchen.title: Kitchen
kitchen.default: Default station (gets everything not claimed by another)

receipt.noBluetooth: Bluetooth printing needs Chrome on Android or a computer.
receipt.failed: Printing failed. Check the printer is on and close by, then try again.

pin.usePassword: Sign in with email and password
pin.help: A 4 to 6 digit PIN lets you sign in quickly on the shop's registered tills. Sign in once with your password on a till, then use your PIN there. Owners always use password and 2FA.
pin.saved: PIN saved. On a registered till, you can now sign in with it.

devices.help: Register a shared till or tablet here, on that device itself. Staff who sign in fully on it can then use their PIN there. Remove a lost device at once.
devices.notAllowed: Only managers and owners register devices.
devices.name: Device name (e.g. Front till)

pl.taxNote: Tax collected for the region (not revenue): {{amount}}
